items.name: Banja Luka Cube Day 2023
items.information:
This is the 9th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The competition is open to all persons from all countries.

There will be certificates for all competitors in top 3 of an event.

================

Ovo je 9. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja.

Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati.

items.name: Banja Luka Cube Day 2022

venue.name: Dom Omladine (Youth Center)
venue.address: Đure Daničića 1, Banja Luka 78000, Bosnia & Herzegovina
venue.details: Follow the signs to enter the venue

items.information:
#### **[English]**

Banja Luka Cube Day 2022 is a speedcubing competition. Anyone can participate, who is familiar with the WCA Regulation, accepts it and meet the competition’s criterias.

Please read all other tabs for more information.

#### **[Bosnian]**

Banja Luka Cube Day 2022 je speedcubing takmičenje. Svako ko poznaje WCA pravila i ispunjava WCA zahtjeve može da učestvuje na takmičenju.

Pročitajte ostale tabove za više informacija.
